# Cesare Davide Pace

> PhD Researcher in Artificial Intelligence and Biomechanics at the University of Cassino and Southern Lazio (UNICAS) and LUNEX University, Luxembourg.

Cesare Davide Pace is an Italian researcher developing AI-powered markerless motion capture systems for biomechanical analysis and clinical diagnosis of neurodegenerative diseases, particularly Parkinson's disease and Alzheimer's disease.

## Research focus
- Markerless motion capture using pose estimation (ViTPose, YOLO-based)
- Gait analysis for Parkinson's disease diagnosis using machine learning
- Handwriting analysis for Alzheimer's disease prediction
- Explainable AI (XAI) for medical applications
- Vision Transformers (ViT) for video-based human pose estimation

## Key publications
- "Markerless Gait Analysis for Parkinson's disease diagnosis" — Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence, Elsevier, 2025. DOI: 10.1016/j.engappai.2025.112031
- "Poseidon: A ViT-based Architecture for Multi-Frame Pose Estimation" — arXiv 2025. https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.08446
- "Uncertainty-Aware Mapping from 3D Keypoints to Anatomical Landmarks" — arXiv 2026
